description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Change Machinery Mode (Fire, Lightning, Poison)], [Awoken Machinist], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Technical Bravo!] to the user

description.name: Awoken Machinist
description.text: Machinist abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Machinist abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Machinist abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Change Machinery Mode (Fire, Lightning, Poison)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Lightning]/[Attach Poison] after using a Fire/Lightning/Poison ability

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Poison
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Poison damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Poison resistance +20%

description.name: Technical Bravo!
description.text: Causes [Imperil Poison 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Fire 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Lightning 10% (15s)] after using two Poison/Fire/Lightning attacks
